findings.evidence: `TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/SymplecticGroup.lean` already hosts `SymplecticGroup.fromBlocks_{upper,lower,diagonal}_mem` with the same `variable {l : Type*} [DecidableEq l] [Fintype l] {R : Type*} [CommRing R]` block and imports only `Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.SymplecticGroup`, the file defining `J`, `J_squared`, `J_inv`, `isUnit_det_J` and `inv_eq_symplectic_inv` (mathlib/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/SymplecticGroup.lean:58,76,81,92,209). It is already on the import path of both new Geometry files via `TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/GeneralLinearGroup/Symplectic/Basic.lean:10`, so no cycle and no lost availability.
findings.fix: Move all four to `TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/SymplecticGroup.lean` and leave only `LieAlgebra.Symplectic.mem_sp` and `mem_sp_iff_transpose_eq_conj` in `Algebra/Lie/Symplectic/Basic.lean`, importing `TauCeti.LinearAlgebra.SymplecticGroup` there.
findings.issue: `Matrix.J_mul_neg_J` (54), `Matrix.neg_J_mul_J` (58), `Matrix.isUnit_J` (62) and `SymplecticGroup.transpose_eq_J_conj_inv` (74) have no Lie-algebra content — they are facts about `Matrix.J` and Mathlib's `Matrix.symplecticGroup` over a `CommRing` — yet they are only reachable by importing a `TauCeti/Algebra/Lie/` module. Symplectic-group/linear-algebra consumers cannot use `IsUnit (J l R)` or `Aᵀ = J * A⁻¹ * J⁻¹` without pulling in Lie theory.

findings.evidence: `TauCeti/Topology/Algebra/OrthogonalGroup.lean:44,50` holds `Matrix.isClosed_orthogonalGroup`/`isClosed_specialOrthogonalGroup`, and the GL-level closedness for the orthogonal case is `QuadraticMap.isClosed_range_specialOrthogonalToGeneralLinear_realCliffordForm` in `TauCeti/Topology/Algebra/QuadraticForm/RealSpecialOrthogonal.lean:108` — `TauCeti/Geometry/Lie/Subgroup/SpecialOrthogonal.lean` imports it (line 13) and merely applies it (line 93) rather than proving closedness inline.
findings.fix: Move it to `TauCeti/Topology/Algebra/SymplecticGroup.lean` alongside the orthogonal analogues (naturally as `Matrix.isClosed_symplecticGroup` over a T1 topological commutative ring plus the GL-level pullback), and import that module here.
findings.issue: `TauCeti.Lie.isClosed_GLSymplectic` is a purely topological statement about `GLSymplectic` (continuity of `A ↦ A * J * Aᵀ` plus a preimage under `Units.val`); it depends on no Lie theory, is broadly useful outside this file, and is placed in a Lie-subgroup file under namespace `TauCeti.Lie`, where topology consumers will not find it.

summary: The Lie-algebra file carries four declarations with no Lie content that belong in the existing TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/SymplecticGroup.lean, and the purely topological closedness of GLSymplectic is proved inside the Lie-subgroup file instead of TauCeti/Topology/Algebra/ where the orthogonal analogues live. Imports are fine.
